note: Submodule of commerce_currency_resolver, requires commerce_shipping + commerce_exchanger. hook_commerce_shipping_method_info_alter swaps flat_rate -> FlatRateCurrency and flat_rate_per_item -> FlatRatePerItemCurrency (no new plugin ids). ShippingCurrencyOrderProcessor (order_processor priority 999) sets the shipping FORCE_REFRESH flag when the resolver flags a currency refresh. No config/schema/permission. Only easy + one introspection tier: there is no clean, self-contained config/entity 'execution' surface (execution would need a full shipping method + shipment fixture), so no hard case is defined - consistent with lighter submodules in this repo. Medium reads the live plugin definition to confirm the class override; no site mutation, so setup only ensures the module is enabled and cleanup is a no-op.

evals.prompt: What does the Commerce Currency Resolver shipping submodule do, and which modules does it require?
evals.expected_output: It makes core flat-rate shipping methods currency-aware (per-currency amount or auto-conversion via Commerce Exchanger) and refreshes shipments when the order currency changes. Requires commerce_shipping and commerce_exchanger.

evals.prompt: How does the Commerce Currency Resolver shipping submodule make shipping methods currency-aware - does it add new shipping method plugins?
evals.expected_output: It does not add new plugin ids; hook_commerce_shipping_method_info_alter swaps the class of the core flat_rate and flat_rate_per_item methods to FlatRateCurrency / FlatRatePerItemCurrency.

evals.prompt: How does the Commerce Currency Resolver shipping submodule ensure shipping rates are recalculated after a currency change?
evals.expected_output: ShippingCurrencyOrderProcessor (order_processor priority 999) reacts to the resolver's currency_order_refresh flag and sets the shipping FORCE_REFRESH flag so shipments recompute rates in the new currency.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which PHP class currently backs the core 'flat_rate' Commerce shipping method plugin? Inspect the live plugin definition.
evals.expected_output: flat_rate is backed by Drupal\commerce_currency_resolver_shipping\Plugin\Commerce\ShippingMethod\FlatRateCurrency (the submodule overrides the core class via hook_commerce_shipping_method_info_alter).
